definitions.explanation: Finding a disease, problem, or condition at an early stage. Most commonly used in medical contexts about detecting illnesses before they progress.

examples.japanese: がん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早期発見|そうきはっけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Early detection is important for cancer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定期|ていき}{検診|けんしん}→定期検診：15678_teikikenshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早期発見|そうきはっけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Regular check-ups lead to early detection of illness.

examples.japanese: {早期発見|そうきはっけん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{完治|かんち}→完治：12268_kanchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to early detection and early treatment, a complete recovery was possible.

notes:
USAGE:
{早期発見|そうきはっけん} combines ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧ (early stage) and ⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧ (detection, discovery). It is most frequently used in medical and health contexts, often paired with {早期治療|そうきちりょう} (early treatment) in the set phrase {早期発見|そうきはっけん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早期発見|そうきはっけん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう} (early detection and early treatment)
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早期発見|そうきはっけん} (early detection of disease)
- {早期発見|そうきはっけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧ (early detection is important)
